description: The same loop as ReAct plus the verification gate E1-E7 on the final answer. E7 reads the request back against the problem the model extracted, so a misread request is escalated rather than answered. The solver-grounded row.
dynamic_parts: ## System Data: the time convention, the step length and the EV labels, from the day's horizon (methods/prompting/strategies.py::_context_section)
## Output Requirements: methods/_shared/agent_output_contract.txt with the shared answer rule filled in (methods/prompting/strategies.py::build_agent_user_message)
the gate's verdict, handed back to the model on the one retry (methods/agent/validate/gate.py)
